reviews.t: Ladies this is an update after reading other reviews, if you are get glitter look top coat not cured enough, try that!
reviews.x: I was so excited to get this new glitter powder!  Came in 7 days. I have put on color, taken it off numerous times to see what works the best. I am a pro at it now! Here are step by step that you HAVE TO DO to get it to turn out.  I am working on getting coats thinner. I know they will look even better after that. 1.  Base Coat and UV Light 2.  I used Black and two of the samples are grey. One THIN coat and UV Light. 3.  Second THIN black coat and UV Light. 4.  No wipe top coat. This is a must!!

The colors turn out darker than the picture shows. I experimented with other gel shades and came up with some brighter options. Must use gel polish and "no wipe gel topcoat". Use a tiny amt. Of powder over the top coat. Rub in. Dust off remaining loose powder and add 2nd topcoat. Powder flies everywhere so cover your workstation for easy cleanup. Wear a smock! *photo #1show all 12 powders over black. *photo #2 shows 4 of the powders over black. The samples opposite of them are the same p

I'm happy with this product but you have to do it correctly. I recommend going to YouTube and looking at some tutorials on using mirror/chrome products. The key is using a no wipe clear coat over the color, or black polish for silver chrome, using just a bit of powder and rub a lot with the sponge wands provided. You really don't need much! I was also very happy to see the order show up much earlier than expected!

There is definitely a learning curve with this product as with any powder chrome effect nail decoration. You definitely need a tack free/no wipe gel top coat. The colors are beautiful however they aren't full on true chrome. I buffed and buffed my nails to get the perfect chrome look however once I put the top coat on to seal in the design, small microfine particles would pull up causing the design to have a chrome effect with microfine glitter floating above. It looks pretty don't get me wrong

Results were gorgeous, just what I wanted, real mirror effect with the silver powder over black. I used my fingers to apply the powder, and it worked best if rubbed a lot with very light pressure. reviews.t: Amazing! Make sure you follow the direction!
reviews.x: This chrome pack is amazing!  I was on the fence when i bought it.  But as soon as i started testing it, i knew it was even better than i hoped for!  Its exactly like the pictures show!  Mixing it with different color combinations is even better than just using the black for the background.  The only advice i can give is MAKE SURE YOU FOLLOW THE DIRECTIONS!  having a no wipe gel top coat is critical to making sure you get the mirrored effect! Couldn't be happier!

The seals on the containers seem to be bad. My kit came in and done of the containers leaked in shipping. I opened the box and fine glitter got everywhere. The inside of the box was coated in glitter. Everything in the box was coated. Now everything in the immediate area around where I opened the box is coated in glitter which is nearly impossible to clean up.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product works well and produces a beautiful mirror/chrome effect once you get the technique right.
Reviewers repeatedly stress there is a learning curve and that you must use a no-wipe/tack-free gel top coat and rub the powder thoroughly for best results.
Several reviewers note the powders look similar or are not clearly labeled, making it hard to tell colors apart and requiring experimentation.
Some reviewers complain the colors turn out darker or not truly chrome compared to the pictures, and a few report packaging/quality problems like spilled or partially filled containers.
A few reviewers praise the price and customer service as strong points.
